content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fails fallback), fallback-level cure proposed.**

- **§ 2(a) grant (p0022)** licenses only "Client" — no affiliates, no contractors, and no notice mechanic to add them (the only written-notice mechanic, § 2(b)(ii) at p0027, covers new *sites*, not entities).
- **§ 15 (p0080)** conditions any assignment on the other party's prior written approval, with a carve-out only for a "financially responsible affiliate" — no successor-in-M&A path.
- Not walk-away: § 2(c) ties licence duration to termination of the Agreement rather than Vendor discretion.

Two surgical replacements: affiliates added to the grant on written notice, and a successor-in-merger/acquisition carve-out appended to the existing consent exception — both validated (ok:true) and within the minimality gate.
